about.title: About me
about.bio: Software Engineer with a degree in Computer Science from UFRJ, experienced in building scalable systems and user-centered products, contributing to the development and evolution of platforms. I work as a full-stack engineer, with a growing focus on architecture and system design. I have been directing my work toward building scalable products and, more recently, developing AI-driven solutions, including agent-based systems. I am particularly interested in connecting engineering decisions with user experience, always aiming to balance technical quality, usability and product impact.
